 ─────────────────────
 Image Organizer CLI
 ─────────────────────
Commands                		organize, list, move, clean  
  iorg organize --source <dir> (-r|--root) <dir> (-p|--pathconv) <1|2|3|4> (-n|--nameconv) <1|2|3>  
  iorg list <FileNamePattern> (-r|--root) <dir> [--subscriber <name>] [--json|--quiet]  
  iorg move <SourceItemId> [<TargetItemId>] (-r|--root) <dir> [--subscriber <name>] [--pathconv <1|2|3|4>]  
  iorg clean <ItemId> (-r|--root) <dir> [--force]  
  iorg clean --cache (-r|--root) <dir>  
-h, --help              		print out all options  
-v, --version           		print version info  
-l, --nologo            		do not display the banner  
-d, --debug             		FALSE  
-c, --cloud             		no DefaultCloudOrder providers are configured  
-s, --source            		no source image directory given  
-rm, --rm               		list images that would be deleted for ShortName  
-rmc, --rm-cache        		list cached images that would be deleted for ShortName  
--force                 		perform exact-ItemId deletion (or legacy -rm/-rmc)  
-p, --pathconv          	󰎪	󰎦 CanonicalByName, 󰎩 ItemIdTree3x3, 󰎬 ItemIdTree8x2 (default), 󰎮 Flat  
-n, --nameconv          	󰎪	󰎦 Legacy, 󰎩 ItemTemplate, 󰎬 Structured (default)  
-r, --root              		destination image root, resolved under --cloud when provided  
ImageRoot: complete destination image root
